metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
source_boundary_notes: Age≤40, high-grade extremity/axial osteosarcoma excluding craniofacial sites; every disease site must be completely resectable.
MAP phase-specific counts: doxorubicin/cisplatin ANC≥0.75 and platelets≥75; MTX ANC≥0.25 and platelets≥50. Rescue is never withheld by a chemotherapy count rule.
Unindexed CrCl≥50 eligibility, indexed70 complication threshold, printed≥50 renal-delay row and current HPRA high-dose<60 contraindication require explicit source/unit reconciliation.
Rescue concentration/time bands, endpoint conflicts,96-hour prior-escalation history and Day 29 wording remain specialist gates.
Doxorubicin absolute-bilirubin decimal gaps/exact 87 and exactLVEF50 require review. Repeat cardiac dysfunction precedes permanent doxorubicin omission.
Cisplatin neuropathy/hearing permanent omissions differ from renal temporary omissions and future restart.
All numeric changes/rescue prescriptions remain blocked; original PDF and visual table mapping unverified.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.

indications.description: Neoadjuvant/adjuvant localised or metastatic high-grade osteosarcoma of an extremity/axial skeleton, excluding craniofacial sites; all disease sites must be amenable to complete surgical resection.

treatment.schedule_summary: Induction weeks 1–10: doxorubicin 37.5 mg/m² and cisplatin 60 mg/m² on Days 1/2 at weeks 1/6; MTX 12000 mg/m² over 4 hours at weeks 4/5/9/10. Surgery reference week 11, with at most two additional consultant-directed preoperative MTX doses if delayed. Postoperative: doxorubicin Days 1/2 at weeks 12/17/22/26; cisplatin Days 1/2 at weeks 12/17; MTX at weeks 15/16/20/21/24/25/28/29. This is not a single repeating cycle.

eligibility: Age≤40; ECOG0–2 and adequate organ function.
Localised or metastatic high-grade osteosarcoma of extremity/axial skeleton, excluding craniofacial sites, with all sites amenable to complete resection.
HDMTX renal eligibility requires explicit specialist reconciliation of source thresholds and units.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to MTX, doxorubicin, cisplatin or excipients.
Congestive heart failure (LVEF<50%) or other significant heart disease.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, coagulation profile, urinalysis for blood/protein/glucose and ECG. Cardiac imaging and audiology as clinically indicated; source >65 imaging text is not an extension of the age≤40 eligibility.
FBC, renal/liver profiles before each treatment. Daily creatinine during MTX; assess hearing/sensory-neural function before each cycle and refer for audiology as indicated.

MTX levels at 24/48/72/96/120 hours as appropriate from infusion START; urine pH≥7 before/during MTX and rescue, checked six-hourly; fluid balance four-hourly. Obtain renal values with explicit indexed/unindexed units.
Evaluate prior dose reductions, FN/G-CSF, cumulative doxorubicin, current/prior cardiac dysfunction, mucositis, hearing and neuropathy before each component.
dose_modifications: Age≤40, high-grade extremity/axial osteosarcoma excluding craniofacial sites; every disease site must be completely resectable.
MAP phase-specific counts: doxorubicin/cisplatin ANC≥0.75 and platelets≥75; MTX ANC≥0.25 and platelets≥50. Rescue is never withheld by a chemotherapy count rule.
Unindexed CrCl≥50 eligibility, indexed70 complication threshold, printed≥50 renal-delay row and current HPRA high-dose<60 contraindication require explicit source/unit reconciliation.
Rescue concentration/time bands, endpoint conflicts,96-hour prior-escalation history and Day 29 wording remain specialist gates.
Doxorubicin absolute-bilirubin decimal gaps/exact 87 and exactLVEF50 require review. Repeat cardiac dysfunction precedes permanent doxorubicin omission.
Cisplatin neuropathy/hearing permanent omissions differ from renal temporary omissions and future restart.
All numeric changes/rescue prescriptions remain blocked; original PDF and visual table mapping unverified.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
additional_supportive_care: Cisplatin phases are high emetogenic risk; HDMTX and doxorubicin-only phases are moderate. Hospital-prescribed hydration/electrolytes are required.

HDMTX prehydration/alkalinisation begins before infusion. Source folinic reference starts24 hours after MTX START, commonly15 mg/m² every 6 hours, but actual rescue depends on concentrations, renal function and prior escalation. This is source-reference text, not an executable rescue prescription.
Hydration<0.1 µmol/L versus rescue<0.15 µmol/L plus6 hours, inconsistent exponent and postoperative11-dose wording require a specialist stop plan; no fixed discharge promise.
Delayed clearance is a potential emergency: ongoing hydration/alkalinisation, folinic adjustment and possible glucarpidase under specialist management. No automated rescue or glucarpidase dosing.
G-CSF is history/delay dependent under Table 4, not an automatically inserted universal prophylaxis.

administration.notes: Alternative continuous48-hour central-line infusion is described; use the authorised prescription.
Hospital hydration/alkalinisation and specialist folinic rescue required; no rescue prescription calculated.
